label: AU-privacy-act-1988 Section 95

obligations.text: (2)	The Commissioner shall not approve the issue of guidelines unless he or she is satisfied that the public interest in the promotion of research of the kind to which the guidelines relate outweighs to a substantial degree the public interest in maintaining adherence to the Australian Privacy Principles.
(3)	Guidelines shall be issued by being published in the Gazette.
